security_audit.summary: Most static command findings are false positives from Markdown code fences and reference paths, not executable backtick code. Three scripts write reports to user-supplied output paths, which creates a bounded overwrite risk. No prompt injection, network access, credential exfiltration, or malicious intent was found.

remediation.suggestion: Validate --output paths, avoid overwriting existing files by default, and prefer writing inside the requested project directory.
Mark install, Docker, and kubectl commands as examples that require explicit user confirmation before execution.
Use a non-overwriting copy step or instruct users to check for an existing .env file first.

content.value_statement: Frontend teams need consistent React and Next.js guidance across projects. This skill provides reference workflows, quality practices, and helper scripts for frontend analysis.
actual_capabilities: Explains React patterns, anti-patterns, and code organization guidance.
Provides Next.js optimization topics for performance and troubleshooting.
Lists frontend quality, security, performance, and maintainability practices.
Includes helper scripts that validate a target path and print an analysis report.
Can optionally write script results as formatted JSON to a chosen output file.
limitations: The helper scripts are generic scaffolds, not full component generators or bundle analyzers.
The reference guides use placeholder examples and require project-specific review.
The documentation includes shell commands that should not run without confirmation.
No tests, lint configuration, or framework integrations are included.

use_cases.title: Plan a Frontend Feature
use_cases.description: Use the references to choose React structure, state boundaries, and quality checks before implementation.

use_cases.title: Review Web App Performance
use_cases.description: Run the analysis helper and use the optimization guide to organize follow-up work.

use_cases.title: Standardize Team Practices
use_cases.description: Turn the included quality, security, and maintainability guidance into shared project conventions.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Component Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to review my React component plan. Identify structure issues, missing states, accessibility needs, and simple improvements.

prompt_templates.title: Improve a Next.js Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to review this Next.js page for performance, data loading, caching, and rendering improvements. Prioritize actionable changes.

prompt_templates.title: Create Frontend Standards
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to draft frontend standards for React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, testing, and maintainability. Keep the rules practical.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Frontend Architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to audit a frontend architecture. Assess state management, component boundaries, bundle risk, security practices, and migration steps.

output_examples.input: Review this React dashboard component for maintainability.
output_examples.output: A prioritized review covering component boundaries, repeated state, accessibility gaps, and targeted refactor steps.

output_examples.input: Analyze this Next.js route for performance problems.
output_examples.output: A concise performance report with rendering concerns, caching opportunities, asset notes, and measurement steps.

output_examples.input: Help define frontend rules for a new team project.
output_examples.output: A team checklist covering structure, naming, state ownership, security basics, testing, and review expectations.

best_practices: Review generated guidance against the actual framework version and project constraints.
Ask before running install, deployment, or file-writing commands from the documentation.
Use the helper scripts for reporting only after confirming target and output paths.
anti_patterns: Do not treat the placeholder scripts as complete production analyzers.
Do not run Docker, kubectl, npm, or pip commands automatically from this skill.
Do not copy environment files over existing local configuration without checking first.

faq.question: Does this skill generate complete React components?
faq.answer: No. The component script is a generic scaffold and does not generate production-ready component code.

faq.question: Can it optimize a Next.js application automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and reporting structure, but changes require human review and implementation.

faq.question: Does it support Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: Does the skill access the network?
faq.answer: No evidence of network access was found in the reviewed files.

faq.question: Why are command examples a risk?
faq.answer: Install and deployment commands can execute local project code or affect infrastructure if run without confirmation.

faq.question: Should users run the helper scripts directly?
faq.answer: Users should inspect target paths and output paths first, then run scripts only when they understand the effect.
